verdict.rationale: CUDA Toolkit documentation explicitly lists GeForce RTX 50 Series as supported, and independent HN/TechPowerUp benchmarks confirm real CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL/Vulkan Compute workloads run on the 5090, corroborating vendor claims of GPU-compute support. Missing for 10: explicit official CUDA compute-capability spec sheet entry for RTX 5090 and no ROCm/HIP angle (not applicable to NVIDIA), and no first-party developer case study of shipped production workloads.
